business_problem: Orange needed to replace an aging enterprise performance management system so finance teams across countries could handle budgeting, forecasting and reporting with better scale and self-service access.
solution_summary: Orange modernized its finance performance-management landscape with IBM Planning Analytics deployed in cloud mode by IBM Consulting and IBM Technology teams. The previous EPM environment had reached its limits in both performance and functionality, making it hard to support the global organization’s budgeting, forecasting and reporting needs. Planning Analytics became the shared SaaS platform for the new Finance Solutions and Data division, giving users a unified data model, large-scale analytics capacity and a familiar Excel-connected interface for ad hoc work. The solution was rolled out across the main countries in which Orange operates and supports a broad set of finance functions for about 1,500 users. By standardizing performance management on a single cloud platform, Orange reduced friction in financial decision-making, improved independent reporting and created a base it can extend with predictive algorithms over time.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides Orange’s cloud-based platform for financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and self-service analysis.

solution_components.name: IBM Consulting
solution_components.role: Led the deployment and adoption program for the new performance-management environment.

data_flow: Financial planning and performance data is consolidated into IBM Planning Analytics, where users across countries can run ad hoc reports, budgeting and forecasting workflows through a shared cloud-based model.
business_outcome: Orange replaced a limiting finance platform with a scalable cloud environment that supports self-service reporting and more streamlined performance management across the group.
